PART I : SECTION (I) — GENERAL
Government Notifications
THE UNIVERSITIES ACT, No. 16 OF 1978
ORDINANCE made by the University Grants Commission under Section 140 read with Section 18 of the UniversitiesAct, No. 16 of 1978.
Secretary,University Grants Commission.
Colombo,12th October 2016.
Ordinance
1. This Ordinance may be cited as the Institute of Indigenous Medicine (Amendment) Ordinance, No. 02 of 2016and shall come into force upon its publication in the Gazette.

2. The Institute of Indigenous Medicine Ordinance, No. 7 of 1979, published in Gazette Extraordinary No. 67/14 of December 21, 1979 as last amended by Ordinance published in Gazette Extraordinary No. 909/13 of February 09,1996 is hereby further amended as follows :
(1) in paragraph 5 thereof, by the substitution for the word “degrees” in sub-paragraph (d) of that paragraph ofthe words “postgraduate degrees, degrees” ;
(2) in paragraph 12 thereof, by the substitution for the word “degrees,” in sub-paragraph (3)(g) of that paragraphof the words “postgraduate degrees, degrees”.
(3) in paragraph 13 thereof, by the substitution for the words “a Department of study” of the words“Departments of study”

THE UNIVERSITIES ACT, No. 16 OF 1978
ORDINANCE made by the University Grants Commission under Section 18 read with Sections 24A and 24B of theUniversities Act, No. 16 of 1978.
Secretary,University Grants Commission.
Colombo,12th October 2016.
Ordinance
1. This Ordinance may be cited as the Gampaha Wickramarachchi Ayurveda Institute (Amendment) Ordinance,No. 03 of 2016 and shall come into force upon its publication in the Gazette.

2. The Gampaha Wickramarachchi Ayurveda Institute Ordinance, No. 01 of 1995, published in GazetteExtraordinary No. 862/8 of March 13, 1995 as last amended by Ordinance published in Gazette ExtraordinaryNo. 909/13 of February 09, 1996 is hereby further amended as follows :-
(1) in paragraph 4 thereof, by the substitution for the word “degrees,” in sub-paragraph (e) of that paragraphof the words “postgraduate degree, degrees,” ;
(2) in paragraph 11 of that ordinance, by the repeal of sub-paragraph (2)(f) thereof, and the substitutiontherefor of the following :-

“(f) to recommed to the University in consultation with the relevant Departmental Committee orCommittees, the postgraduate degrees, degrees, diplomas, certificates and other academicdistinctions which shall be awarded in the several branches of Ayurveda and the courses of study andtraining to be followed, the examinations to be passed, and other conditions to be satisfied bystudents who wish to qualify for such postgraduate degrees, degrees, diplomas, certificates andother academic distinctions ;” ;
(3) in paragraph 15 thereof, by the substitution for the word “degrees,” in sub-paragraph (e) of that paragraphof the words “postgraduate degrees, degrees,”.
